descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-10 Pre-Rounding Summary · S30 AI Check through the real Save Note, both modes: undictated panels stay empty, and today's note says vitals were not dictated

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U9 AI Check: a dictation that never mentions diagnostic tests, labs or vitals leaves those panels empty or 'Not dictated', never filled with invented values; … (UAT TC-10 AI Check; TFA-92588 AC 7; UAT 3.2; UAT 3.4) — gate: blocked: TFA-92588 ready for pr
  • U14 Today's note never includes a vital or lab not refreshed today, and if no vitals were dictated today it says so. Vitals, labs and imaging each show the date they were recorded (dated panels are not o … (UAT 3.7; UAT 3.4)
  • U10 Every step works, and must pass, in both Hospital and Nursing Home. (UAT 3.3; TFA-94745 AC 6)

Test design technique: Boundary values (boundary) — Sit right on the edge of the rule (exactly on time / a minute late, empty, longest, most) and see on which side the behavior changes.

Given The make-session Hospital patient and Nursing Home resident, nothing on file

When Type the H-03 text (Hospital) and the N-04 text (Nursing Home) from S08, Save Note, look at the Pre-Round panels, then press Generate Note & Finish and open today's note

Then Vitals, Labs and Diagnostic Testing show their empty states (Q7) in both modes; nothing invented; today's note says vitals were not dictated and invents no normals

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): scripts/oracle.mjs: the empty-state strings (Q7) on the Pre-Round tab after Save; on the note, 'Not dictated' (3.4: 'Undictated sections read Not dictated'; 3.7: 'if no vitals were dictated today, it says so') and no invented normals. This is the app's own write path for U9, so lane B (S08, 'model + exported guards') cannot hide a hook that stops calling a guard. …

Where it ran: dev; test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (automated)

S30 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-10.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: AGENT · Browser agent; secondary: AICHECK · AI output check — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on dev; Source: dev.
